posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked:
I think it's time for another Grudge Match. Same rules as before, except I am making Ambuscade a 1, and Gloomweaver a 2, unless people object to it. For a tie-breaker, I am going to hand pick a final match. If it is still a tie, all tied teams win.

You can sign up your team here. I will wait a bit for the teams to sign up before posting the first match.

 

Quick summary of the rules:

*There are 4 rounds. The first is against a random difficulty 1 villain, then a difficulty 2, etc.

*A random environment will be chosen, but an environment from that expanstion won't be chosen agains.

*You can choose any heroes to fight in a round, but those heroes cannot be used again for this event.

*No promo heroes or villains. No Vengeance heroes.
